title: aksar OCR page
description: Output of aksar_ocr::OcrPage::to_json and `aksar ocr --json`. Version 1: new keys may be added in minor releases, so readers must ignore unknown keys.

schema.description: Schema version of this page format.

lines.description: Text lines top to bottom, in recognition order.

document.description: The checked text: the aksar Document (crates/aksar/schema/document.schema.json), with page source "image".

x.description: Left edge on the straightened page, in pixels.

y.description: Top edge on the straightened page, in pixels.

recognized.description: Best reading of the line, before checking.

confidence.description: How sure the recognizer is of `recognized`; 0 for a failed or blank line.
